narrative.intro: Csi Aviation has $1.3B in contract obligations in FY2026 to date across 9 awards, with an average award size of $143M and year-over-year change up 94.9%. The Department of Homeland Security accounts for $1.3B of obligations in FY2026 to date. Obligations by fiscal year show a steady climb from $2.4M in FY21 to $1.3B in FY26, with intermediate totals of $4.8M in FY22, $162M in FY23, $350M in FY24, and $661M in FY25. Market activity is concentrated in All Other Travel Arrangement and Reservation Services, which totals $1.3B in FY2026 to date. Nonscheduled Chartered Passenger Air Transportation records $2.3M. The note clarifies that figures are contract obligations except where tables list award-value figures as total contract values, and that current-year totals are partial fiscal year to date. This profile focuses on dollar volumes, agency buyers, market NAICS, and the trend in obligations over the last six fiscal years.

sections.heading: Who are the main federal buyers of Csi Aviation?
sections.body: The Department of Homeland Security obligated $1.3B for Csi Aviation in FY2026 to date. The Department of Defense obligated $1.7M and the Department of Energy obligated $721K in the same period. These three agencies are the top buyers listed for FY2026 to date.

sections.heading: How has Csi Aviation’s federal revenue changed over time?
sections.body: Obligations rose from $2.4M in FY21 to $1.3B in FY26, passing through $4.8M in FY22, $162M in FY23, $350M in FY24, and $661M in FY25. FY2026 to date obligations are up 94.9% year over year. The company captured $1.3B in obligations through 9 awards in FY2026 to date.

faq.q: How much does Csi Aviation make from federal contracts?
faq.a: Csi Aviation has received $1.3B in contract obligations in FY2026 to date. The company received those obligations across 9 awards, with an average award size of $143M. Fiscal-year obligations rose from $661M in FY25 to $1.3B in FY26.

faq.q: Which agencies buy from Csi Aviation?
faq.a: The Department of Homeland Security buys most from Csi Aviation, obligating $1.3B in FY2026 to date. The Department of Defense obligated $1.7M and the Department of Energy obligated $721K in FY2026 to date.

faq.q: What does Csi Aviation sell to the government?
faq.a: Csi Aviation sells travel and air-transport services to the government. All Other Travel Arrangement and Reservation Services totals $1.3B in FY2026 to date, and Nonscheduled Chartered Passenger Air Transportation totals $2.3M.

faq.q: Which Csi Aviation contracts are expiring soon?
faq.a: No expiring-contracts data is listed in the provided figures. The available tables include obligations by year, top buying agencies, and top markets for FY2026 to date but do not list expiring contracts.
